verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the GitHub feature list naming "Pinning Rules (Merchandising)". That is a manual merchandising control over result order, which counts as a custom ranking rule, but it is a single bare mention with no documentation of how it works. Hybrid search and filters are about retrieval and narrowing results, not ranking by business signals, so they do not deliver the story. Missing for 10: field boosting or custom scoring functions, ranking by numeric business signals (popularity, recency, margin), documented ranking-rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
